La culture amazighe (berbère) est l'une des plus anciennes et des plus riches du pourtour méditerranéen. Portée par les Imazighen ('les hommes libres'), elle s'étend à travers toute l'Afrique du Nord (Tamazgha). Tell me about the Amazigh (Berber) heritage.

The Amazigh people (Imazighen, meaning 'free men') are the indigenous people of North Africa, with a continuous history spanning millennia across Tamazgha. What is Yennayer and why is it celebrated?

Yennayer is the Amazigh New Year, celebrated on January 12th. Historically linked to the accession of King Sheshonq I in 950 BC, it is deeply connected to agrarian life, nature, and the renewal of the earth's bounty. Families celebrate by preparing a feast of couscous with seven vegetables and local fowl.
